MILESTONE: NSFW Program (Not Safe For Work) — 3-week sprint ending Demo Day Feb 26, 2026

WHAT HAPPENED:
- Week 1: Launched MVP ✅ (Whisnap launched Feb 10)
- Week 2: Get users ❌ (~10 users from ~100 visitors)
- Week 3: Monetize ❌ (€0 revenue)
- Demo Day: Presented honest pitch. Didn't win anything. No investor interest.

PITCH: 3 min, 7 slides. Key slide: 'In 3 weeks, I learned what takes most founders 3 months.' Honest about 10 users, €0.

POST-DEMO STATE:
- Bored of Whisnap, doesn't want to work on it anymore
- Job offer: €3000/month, deadline March 9 — financially solves things but 'would feel bad existentially'
- Pivot direction: content-first / build-in-public, scripting first YouTube video

INVESTOR:
- MOC reached out post-demo: 'Saw you at latest basedspace tournament. Investing early up to EUR 3M.'
- Ned not motivated but acknowledged it's worth taking the call
- Call prep: lead with solo founder building full-stack from zero, market validated by Wispr Flow ($50M raise), content-first distribution as growth plan
